citacoes.trecho: Through a detailed analysis, we identify common code generation errors across the models and propose Hint-Driven Prompts to address logic errors, alongside the Syntax Mitigation Prompt to reduce syntax bugs.
To assist LLMs in identifying and correcting logic errors, we propose a Hint-Driven Prompting methodology, which encompasses two approaches: USACO Hint Prompting and GPT-4o Refined Hint Prompting.
Specifically, the USACO solution hints written in English is first provided to GPT-4o along with the original problem statement for context.
The refined solution hints generated by GPT-4o are subsequently fed into the LLMs, and their generated code are evaluated in the same manner as before.
Note: This Syntax Mitigation Prompt is given alongside the GPT-4o refined hints for LLMs to generate code.
Specifically, 36.8% of the test cases that fail are due to logic errors in the code generated by LLMs.
This is evident from the high occurrence of “timeout” errors when evaluating code on our proposed USACO benchmark, which features complex test cases.
First, USACO is less likely to be included in training data compared to other coding platforms like CodeForces, minimizing concerns of benchmark leakage and overfitting [21].
Five models out of 11 models tested were selected to show an overall decrease in syntax bugs, including Deepseek-Coder 33B, Codellama 70B, Codegemma 7B, Llama 3 8B, and GPT-4o.

extracoes.condicoes: Geração via Ollama; execução com limite de 5 s por caso; parâmetros de decodificação e número de execuções não informados. O resumo expressa o resultado como aumento de 6.6x na taxa de aprovação; a contagem sem dicas do DBRX é 41 na Tabela II e 42 na Tabela III. Conferido visualmente na Tabela III (p. PDF 9).
extracoes.selecao_motivo: O resumo declara como resultado principal o aumento da taxa de aprovação pelo Hint-Driven Prompt em vários modelos, sem agregado impresso; usou-se o primeiro modelo na ordem de apresentação do resumo (DBRX 132B). Os fatores do resumo correspondem à condição GPT-4o Refined Hints vs. No Hints.
extracoes.localizador: p. PDF 9 (impressa 474), Tabela III; p. PDF 1 (impressa 466), resumo

citacoes.trecho: Our results demonstrate that the Hint-Driven Prompt boosts pass rates for DBRX 132B, Deepseek-Coder 33B, Codegemma 7B, Codellama 7B, Llama 3, and GPT-4o by 6.6x, 4.7x, 3x, 2.5x, 2.1x, and 25%, respectively.
DBRX 132B experiences a significant enhancement as well, with test cases passed increasing from 49 to 278, an improvement of 229 test cases.

citacoes.trecho: Additionally, the Syntax Mitigation Prompt significantly reduces syntax errors, with reductions of 71.32% for Codegemma 7B, 25.56% for Deepseek-Coder 33B, 23.39% for Llama 3, and 11.19% for Codellama 70B.

Deepseek-Coder 33B decreases from 450 to 335 test cases (25.56%), Codellama 70B decreases from 1,242 to 1,103 test cases (11.19%), Codegemma 7B decreases from 1,285 to 369 test cases (71.32%), and Llama 3 decreases from 425 to 326 test cases(23.39%).

Models like Codegemma 7B which decreases from 1,286 to 369 SyntaxError test cases, are brought to a more competitive level among other models with a chance of testing its code logically instead of syntactically.

qualidade.justificativa: Três questões de pesquisa explícitas (benchmark, tipos de erro, abordagens sem retreinamento) e contribuições enumeradas.

O pipeline (crawling, formato do prompt, geração via Ollama, verificação com limite de 5 s, pontuação) e os prompts das técnicas são descritos, mas não são informados parâmetros de decodificação, número de execuções, versões/quantização dos modelos no Ollama nem o template completo de inserção das dicas; 'three versions of code' não é explicado; cinco modelos foram selecionados para as figuras de sintaxe.
